description: This file implements the MediaKeysClient class, which handles IPC communication for media key events such as license requests, renewals, and key status changes in a media playback system. It interacts with an IPC client to send various event messages related to media key management.

classes.name: MediaKeysClient
classes.description: A class responsible for sending media key related events over IPC, including license requests, renewals, and key status updates.

methods.name: MediaKeysClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MediaKeysClient with a handle and IPC client.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Sends a license request event with the provided key session ID, license message, and URL.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Sends a license renewal event with the provided key session ID and renewal message.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Sends a key status change event with the provided key session ID and key statuses.
